name: Dr. Punjabrao Deshmukh Vasatigruh Nirvah Bhatta Yojna
description: Under this scheme, scholarship is applicable for the economically weaker sections. The student’s those who have taken an admission for Professional courses which come Under Directorate of Art Government /Non-government aided/Partially Aided -Unaided/Permanent Unaided College and Non-Agricultural Universities and Sub-Centers (Excluding Private Universities / Self-financed Private Universities).

evidence.quote: 1. Applicant should be Domicile of Maharashtra.

criteria.label: 2. For professional courses, Applicant should be a child of registered labor , child of Alpabhudarak or both as total annual income of family/ Guardian should not be more than 8 lakh.

evidence.quote: 2. For professional courses, Applicant should be a child of registered labor , child of Alpabhudarak or both as total annual income of family/ Guardian should not be more than 8 lakh.

criteria.label: 3. Applicant should submit Family Annual Income Certificate.

evidence.quote: 3. Applicant should submit Family Annual Income Certificate.

criteria.label: 4. As per Government Resolution first two children eligible for scheme.

evidence.quote: 4. As per Government Resolution first two children eligible for scheme.

criteria.label: 5. Candidates are eligible those who have taken an admission under general category.

evidence.quote: 5. Candidates are eligible those who have taken an admission under general category.

criteria.label: 6. Applicant should be hosteller.(Govt/Private hostel/ Paying Guest/ Tenant.)

evidence.quote: 6. Applicant should be hosteller.(Govt/Private hostel/ Paying Guest/ Tenant.)

criteria.label: 7. Applicant should not avail any other Nirvah Bhatta benefit.

evidence.quote: 7. Applicant should not avail any other Nirvah Bhatta benefit.

criteria.label: 8. During course, candidate should not have a gap of 2 years.

evidence.quote: 8. During course, candidate should not have a gap of 2 years.

criteria.label: 9. Applicant should attempt every semester or annual exam.

evidence.quote: 9. Applicant should attempt every semester or annual exam.

2. To Renew the application, the students should use an application ID, The list published onwebsite of Department- Directorate of Art.
applicationProcess: For Academic Year 2026-27, apply on the MahaDBT 2.0 portal (fresh and renewal applications). The scheme page on MahaDBT 1.0 remains the information source.

applicationUrlEvidence.quote: Fresh and renewal applications for the Academic Year 2026-27 will be accepted only through the MahaDBT 2.0 Portal.
